_what_this_is: The empirical basis for RECOVERY_TRAINER_BYTES in scripts/pod/autoinit_phase_a_driver.py. It exists because the previous value was a constant somebody chose rather than a quantity anybody measured: 22 GiB, against a trainer whose measured peak is 39.79 GiB. require_headroom therefore passed on recovery continuation attempt 4 with 12.32 GiB of apparent slack, and the probe OOM'd. A guard whose threshold is written rather than measured is a guess wearing a gate's clothing.
basis: exact-recipe historical peak, measured after completed optimizer steps
why_not_attempt_4s_footprint: Attempt 4 OOM'd inside the first kd_forward_kl, BEFORE loss.backward() and before the first AdamW.step(). Its 36.30 GiB is a lower bound only: gradients and the two AdamW moment tensors had not fully materialized. Using it as the requirement would rebuild the same defect at a higher number.

measurement.metric: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(), recorded by the trainer at src/aadistill/training/train.py:1305 as gpu_mem_gb
measurement.agreement: sa and sb report the identical peak, 39.79 GiB, each over a COMPLETED 1023-step run (102 logged points, steps 10..1020, rising to 39.79 and flat thereafter)
measurement.device: NVIDIA L40S — the same card class the continuation runs on

recipe_identity.only_difference: data_dir — artifacts/stage3/ladder_uniform_probe vs artifacts/stage3/ladder_uniform, which is the staged pack path and one of the allowed PROBE_OVERRIDES. It does not change block_len, batch or packing, so it cannot change the memory profile.
recipe_identity.note: Every memory-relevant field of the frozen recipe is reproduced exactly, so this is the recipe Phase-A probes run, not an analogue.

conversion_to_device_bytes.why: require_headroom compares against the DRIVER's free_bytes — what a sibling process can actually obtain. max_memory_allocated counts only PyTorch's live tensors, so two observed overheads are added to convert a PyTorch figure into a device figure.
conversion_to_device_bytes.observed_from: recovery continuation attempt 4's own OOM message, which decomposes the trainer process exactly

consequences.attempt_4_would_now_be_refused: free was 36.32 GiB against 41.65 + 2.00 margin = 43.65 required; short by 7.33 GiB, so the gate refuses at $0.36 with a diagnosis instead of losing the probe to an OOM
consequences.headroom_after_repair_a: with the teacher and evaluator actually released, attempt 4's free would have been ~43.87 GiB, which clears the requirement by ~0.22 GiB
consequences.margin_unchanged: the existing 2 GiB require_headroom margin is kept; nothing in this evidence says its semantics are wrong
consequences.TIGHTNESS_WARNING: 41.65 + 2.00 = 43.65 GiB required against a 44.39 GiB card leaves only 0.74 GiB for the driver process, including its CUDA context. This recipe genuinely almost fills an L40S. That is a property of the frozen recipe, which is NOT to be changed to widen the margin; it is the reason a live retention of any size is fatal and why the release must actually release.

not_purchased: No calibration launch was bought. The peak comes from runs that already happened and whose logs were retained; the overheads come from attempt 4's own failure message.
